Interface IGuiCraftingPlanView

All Superinterfaces:
net.minecraft.client.gui.components.events.GuiEventListener, net.minecraft.client.gui.narration.NarratableEntry, net.minecraft.client.gui.narration.NarrationSupplier, net.minecraft.client.gui.components.Renderable, net.minecraft.client.gui.components.TabOrderedElement
All Known Implementing Classes:
GuiCraftingPlan, GuiCraftingPlanFlat, GuiCraftingPlanGraph
public interface IGuiCraftingPlanView extends net.minecraft.client.gui.components.events.GuiEventListener, net.minecraft.client.gui.components.Renderable, net.minecraft.client.gui.narration.NarratableEntry
A gui component that visualizes a crafting plan. The using gui must call the following methods from its respective method: * Renderable.extractRenderState(GuiGraphicsExtractor, int, int, float) * drawGuiContainerBackgroundLayer(GuiGraphicsExtractor, float, int, int) * drawGuiContainerForegroundLayer(GuiGraphicsExtractor, int, int) * GuiEventListener.mouseScrolled(double, double, double, double) * GuiEventListener.mouseDragged(MouseButtonEvent, double, double) * GuiEventListener.mouseReleased(MouseButtonEvent)
